text: Proudly displayed in the window is a 'The best of Montco 2019 Best Zep's'  sign.  I have had good Zep experiences, and apparently Eve's are the best, so I ordered one.  The large zep was $14.50, you know I am not a fan of that.  I will give Eve major props.  She had a sign up that due to price increases during COVID there was an additional charge sandwiches (above the $14.50).  It's a pandemic, people understand you have to pass the increase on to the consumer, supermarkets do it.  The large zep was very good.  It is on a very good but very bready roll.  Sneaky good amount of good meat.  I prefer the meat chopped but it was good.  I would have liked a little bit more cheese.  The zep flavor overpowered everything but that is what I guess it is supposed to do.

The manager and hostess were amazing and they have bottomless mimosas. The jambalaya was the best part of the meal though. My omelet was terrible, the gumbo left something to be desired and most of our food came out wrong. We waited over an hour to be seated but the manager was really friendly about it. The waitress was way to busy to pay attention to our table and we were often times looking around for someone. I would like to see what their lunch menu has but I won't order anything with eggs here again. I'll probably only come again for the bottomless mimosas

My family and I were on our way back home and decided to stop for some breakfast and this location did not disappoint one bit. First off, all the employees were really friendly which made our breakfast pleasant! Their menu all sounds and is delicious! They have lots of variety which made it hard to decide, but I ended up getting the the #1 breakfast sandwich with a Jalapeño cheddar bagel. Our sandwiches were freshly made, warm and everything and more you could want in a bagel. This place absolutely exceeded my expectations and it was very easy to find with lots of parking. This was the BEST bagel I've ever had! I will for sure come back to try out more bagels!

Not worth the hype. I was honestly SO EXCITED to visit Cafe Du Monde and try the famous Beignets. But... it's not the best honestly. Unless you're a big funnel cake person then you'll love them. However for me.. not worth waiting in these long lines. I got lucky and visited the location right outside the NOMA where the line was not as long. However, the Cafe Au Lait was delicious. Coffee-4. Beignets-2 out of 5.
Some of the best pizza I've ever had, Bone collector being my favorite. Also a fantastic beer selection that is constantly changing!

the waitreses were absolutly disrespectful on another level they had zero patience and kicked us out even after we made a reservation they said exactly,"you need to leave there are people waiting for the table", we asked for a to go box tey said,"i dont care get out" we asked to speak to the manager and we were threatened if we didnt leave they were going to call the police. I would not recommend this place unless you want to be disrespected like its your fault that people cant be seated and keep in mine we were only seated and hour and 30 minutes and its took 30 minutes for the food to come.

Thank you, next.

Ordered delivery from Zaxby's because we wanted something different. we're about 7 minutes from the restaurant. Hubby and I got boneless wings, chicken fingers, sides, and a chicken salad.
This is not anything special. Probably the best part was the french fries. 
To start, we're unpacking the bag and they only sent ranch dressing. we ordered several of the sauces because we wanted to try them and we got zero.
Second, the chicken is not flavorful. It's just breading with no spices. Maybe it would have been better had we had something to dip it in. The toast was burnt, hard, and dry. The salad though was ginormous. It was good but it wasn't enough to save this meal. 
Maybe we'll try Zaxby's again in the restaurant after we forget this experience. Until then, pass.

My wife and I went here if you weeks ago I did a friend of mine and myself if you weeks before that and both times were exceptionally good. The food here is always very clean tasting which is fantastic. service here is top-notch with excellent recommendations as well when it comes to the food. This is pretty important considering that one of the first times I've ever eaten Thai food was at this particular restaurant. Most of the menu is a little confusing unless you've done a little research ahead of time or had previous experience with Thai food so their assistance with selection is wonderful. I particularly recommend the Thai tea as it is exceptionally delicious and worth every penny. The Thai coffee is also extremely good but it is exceptionally strong and will keep you awake for a long time so just be aware when ordering this for dinner. The prices for what you are getting food wise are also very good and I feel there's a very decent balance when it comes to cost vs food quality and quantity. Highly recommend

I've been here multiple times prior to now with family and I decided to take some friends here tonight and we've been waiting roughly an hour on a non busy night. In addition we've only ordered garlic knots and a pizza plus a few dr peppers to which they didn't have and we ended up getting Pepsi. I recommend the food from prior visits, however not warning us there will be an hour wait is absolutely unacceptable! I don't know if I will be returning after this experience. In addition, garlic knots didn't taste like garlic. Pizza was good, however not worth the wait.

We went there for Thanksgiving the food tasted like they just took it out of a can no taste. Definitely would not recommend and sure I'm not ever going back! Don't waste your money!! I have had better TV dinners! Way over priced!!

I always take family here when they come into town! It's a St. Louis classic. Splurge on a plate, and you'll have food for at LEAST another meal, and the mac and cheese is a must. This is more like a once-a-year place for me because it is always so delicious but very heavy!
Not my favorite restaurant/bar in St. Louis. Been there one or times - rude staff who smoke right outside the restaurant. Food is okay. Drinks are sweet and nothing to brag about.
Disappointed!!!!!! Over priced and they dont serve liquor. I was shocked. Who eat tacos and dont drink a margarita?

Better than your standard pub food.

Service - 5 stars, attentive and dog friendly.

Food - Had the pretzel and cheese appetizer which was great.  Soft pretzel balls and a mini fondue cheese dip. The Pub burger hit the spot.  Cooked to order and not your lazy frozen patty burger which is all too common these days. Finally the Monkey Bread which is basically a deconstructed apple pie.  Moist, not too sweet and served a la mode. 

I noticed some fire places and a few games like corn hole in the back but didn't get a chance to check that area out.  Worth a stop.

I wasn't really expecting to like this place.  I tend to get bored of ping pong pretty quickly.  I went with a party, maybe 20 people.  We had a section carved out for us, and had access to a little satellite bar.  I have no idea what was going on the night that we were there, but there was all sorts of free stuff going around.  Ice cream sandwiches from Big Gay Ice Cream, free drinks, some handed us a whole pizza.  It was strange... in a good way.  I am assuming that isn't typical, but even without all of that free stuff it was a good time.  I like that they don't seem to take the ping pong aspect too seriously, there were balls flying everywhere and the staff didn't bat an eye.  They even seemed to get a kick out of it.  

Lot's of instagramable stuff, I'm sure you've seen the tub.  If that's something you look for, there is plenty of it.

I'm glad I made it to Kilroy's in Broad Ripple to hang out and have some beers.  My friends and I came to watch the Pacers game and Ball state game.  It is a nice space with a huge bar area.  I did notice they only had 6 top tables and not that many small tables with 2 seats, which I'm sure was because of Covid-19,  but some of my friends found it discouraging.  The drink specials were great and we took advantage of them with the $2 Miller lite and coor's light.   I ordered the smoked chicken and artichoke panini with tater tots for lunch and it was delicious!!  Our server was awesome and gave us wonderful customer service.    They have plenty of TV all around the bar which made it easy to watch the game. All in all, Kilroy's is a great place to hangout and watch a sports game. Their stuffed breadsticks are amazing!!  They have a variety of long Island cocktails and bombs which are supposedly very good.   I will have to try one the next time I go to Kilroy's.   This is a great place!!

We only stopped in for a couple of drinks. Loved our waitress - I get the feeling it wouldn't take long for them to feel like a regular. It's definitely divey and I can't speak for the food, but we had a fun time.
Food was delicious, service was fast and friendly. Tables were not spaced out well, but it was a busy Friday night.

This bar has come up with the most unique way to follow covid protocols by using moving pods as private dining rooms. Each pod has its own heater and curtains to help keep you warm in the cold weather. They now have plexiglass windows in your pods where servers can hand you your food and drinks. I got there about an hour after they opened (they opened at 5pm). I had to wait about ten minutes for a pod to open up, but they have a heated porch to wait under and gave us menus to look at while we waited. They do make sure to thoroughly clean out each pod after they are used. 

Now on to the good stuff! I ordered a Mai Tai and my friend ordered a Scorpion Reef. These drinks are STRONG lol. They also have a small selection of beer for people who don't like mixed drinks. The best part of my experience was the food. We ordered the mozzarella sticks ($10), loaded fries ($10), and split a burger ($8). The burger was literally one of the best burgers I've ever had. It was easily in my top 5 if not higher. I do believe some of the food comes from the restaurant next door called The Heartbreaker. My friend and I spent the whole ride home talking about how we can't wait to get another meal here.

Honestly not worth the money. My fiancé and I went here because we hear great things. The outdoor seating was very nice. The service it self was lack luster. We sat down for a total of a  hour and half it took about 20 minutes to get my drink, which tasted like rubbing alcohol. I put all the food in at one because I want to try the small plates and my fiancé order the beef bowl. The food can be described as one word SALTY! Omg I was so sick after. The food was for the most part cold when it came out which I'm not sure if it was because we were outside of because they just didn't care. The couple next to us was complaining when we got there. I should have took their advice on this. Please if you have any condition that you cannot have salt, I would stay away!!
Went on opening day and the service was super fast. Walked in at 3:15p and had my burger in hand by 3:25p. Of course, I didn't make it very far down the road before the burger was gone. DELICIOUS!!

I hate writing short reviews / get the French toast bagel - take it home and place in your best toaster - toast to your preference - we all know how to play with our toasters -// whipped butter - keep it to yourself - no need to tell....
Insanely good food! Downright addictive and much healthier than other "fast" food options.
Great pizza good music and nice atmosphere. Plenty of outdoor seating and outdoor ordering in the back. Fun to watch the boats go in and out. Service was great.

This is a fabulous spot for breakfast and lunch! With plenty of options on the menu from crabcakes Benedict,  to creme brulee French toast,  I have not been disappointed with anything I have eaten! The server was excellent the facilities clean and freshly decorated. I highly recommend this establishment for a great start to your day! Bravo,  Caleb!!

Cheese steaks  are great, however I come here for their roast pork. This is my runner up for best roast pork in south philly. The lines move quickly and sometimes seating is a pain ( especially if it is a busy sports night). However you can stand around and once someone gets up make your move!! He owner tony is a really great guy and well and does a lot for the community. Food taste better when the owner isn't a weirdo. I suggest the Italian pork and cheese fries!!

Highly recommend the Baja Fish Tacos!
Outdoor seating available. Tables are disinfected are each customer.  Clean bathrooms. Friendly staff.
Love their chicken with the Alabama white sauce and those decadent little rolls!  I've used them for catering many times and they've been great!

Yum. This place has been consistently delicious every time we've diner here while in Tucson. They have quite an extensive menu. We've had a variety of the offerings and have enjoyed everything. My favorite is the dessert case -- the confetti cake is THE BEST. Wish I could have it everyday. 
We were just there on Monday afternoon (around 2 PM) and it was so packed that people were waiting for tables. This seems like quite a popular place, probably for non-vegans too. It took a long time to get our food out this last time because it was so crowded, but we were patient and the food quality and taste were well worth the wait. The wait staff is also super nice. Great place! We look forward to going back. We love this vegan restaurant.

We came in for a late lunch with the weather today. We decided to sit at the bar so we could also watch the game. Christian the bartender did a terrific job of keeping us satisfied as well as answering all of our questions. The manager Tim was also terrific and went above and beyond to make us feel very welcomed. To top off the service the crab claws and Seafood platter were AMAZING!!!  We usually frequent the elm wood location but I think we have found a new home at the one on Manhattan. Thanks for the enjoyable afternoon the staff gave us and we will be back!!
This is a great sushi restaurant which has exceptional rolls!  A must try if you haven't already!
Frosé. Need I say more!! The steak salad is amazing, and the corn bread jalapeño muffins are a great start.

This has got to be one of the best places I have ever eaten sushi. There were so many options, flavors and ideas! The wait was long but totally worth it. The flavors of the sushi were amazing. I will absolutely be going back and bringing many more people with me!
These are very yummy and spicy.The shop is clean and waiters are kind. I think this restaurant is the best Thai restaurant in Alabama!
Make sure you triple check, no make that quadruple check, the order before you pay at the register window because they *will* charge you for the wrong order.

DO NOT GO HERE 

My husband and I came here on a Saturday night around 8pm and all the food looked awful. I asked if they had crab legs and they pointed to an empty container of whah looked like shells. Then the women's bathroom was shut down so they made me go to the men's bathroom, where it smelt awful of feces and there was even sewage on the walls and coming out of some of the toilets. 

This place needs to be checked out by the health department. Do not go here. We went to IHOP instead and it was much better.

Patachou's original digs, this is a super trendy place to be seen breakfast/lunch  joint near the Meridian Kessler area. When possible, the food is locally sourced and fresh. There's an omelette of the day that comes with fruit and toast. (Get the cinnamon toast!) If you're not feeling like an omelette, there are plenty of other options on the menu. 

Serve yourself coffee and settle in for really great food. You can't go wrong.

Amazing spot. Somehow manages to feel cozy and open. 

I had the Pasta Cacio e Pepe. It was cheesy and delicious.

Great artisan food choices, hip atmosphere and friendly vendors. Long Chim Nola - Christy, one of the  artisan chefs serves up wonderful curry and salads. Empa Nola has a variety of Empanadas. Get a sampler platter of 3. I had the Latin American choices - yum! 
Very clean and quiet environment

This place is a great place to eat in Apollo Beach. There's very few nice places to eat in Apollo Beach and this place is a nice change with good food and service. Nick I was awesome and the clams casino is the best.. The pizza is very close to the real deal. Just got back from Italy last week and the pizza is very very similar..

Super flavorful food, but not too spicy if you get the level 3 spice. I was happy with everything I got and the service was extremely fast. The only slight complaint is that if you order any protein on the side, it does not come seasoned at all. Avoid this if possible

OMG yummmmm!!!!

Jelly filled powdered donut holes are genius and so friggin delicious!!

I had pizza from this place free at some event and it seemed great.  I needed to try it on my own dime to make sure.  I got two large double pepperoni pizzas (for only $19 thanks to their Facebook coupon).  I was in pizza heaven.  Good crust, good sauce and most importantly the pepperoni.  The pepperoni was the perfect level of crispiness without being burned and was even a touch spicy.  Thought I even ran into some fresh basil.  This is my new favorite Reno pizza!

A friend recommended coming here, but somehow I didn't realize it was a more formal place. Most of the people in the restaurant were more dressed up compared to at a nicer restaurant in California. 

Drinks: their cocktail portions are generous. The Lucky #7 was solid, well balanced. They also had a pretty good selection of wines by the glass - I would definitely recommend wine for the food. 

Menu: They have two tasting options, which are quite reasonably priced by California standards. There's also an a la carte menu, and you can order individual dishes off the tasting menu, which is nice. 

Food: 
1. Bread: they start you with a warm epi baguette with butter. 
2. Amuse: a garlic Parmesan custard with cauliflower hollandaise and cajun caviar
3. Crab beignet: 3 small beignets - mostly crab, not too much breading; frisée on the side 
4. Chopped salad: beets, dragon fruit, carrots, roasted turnips - refreshing and clean tasting, with beautiful colors 
5. Gnocchi: with blue crab, black truffle, parmesan - the gnocchi is the pillowy type. The flavor was good, but I could have used a bit more salt 
6. Flounder Pontchartrain: with a light thin crisped layer on top of the fish, great flavors, with shrimp, crawfish, and crab
7. Cornmeal chess pie: with popcorn ice cream, strawberries, popcorn. This was a good, lighter dessert. It had lots of textures and wasn't too sweet. 

For me, highlights were the flounder and the cornmeal chess pie. 

Definitely make a reservation for Friday or

Wonderful food. I ordered the cream cheese rangoons as an appetizer, which were wonderful. I also highly recommend the Hanoi roll for an appetizer as well. For lunch I ordered the general chicken. Generous portion size, and great taste. Service is, as always, fast and efficient. Great local joint.

Dined in.  Food was excellent as was service.  Was there around 2:00 in the afternoon and not very busy at that time on Saturday. Crawfish Etouffee was just like I used to eat when I lived in Louisiana.

The funny thing about this place is it's a wing place but I think everything they have is better then the wing sauces...the extra hot is standard hot sauce heat and the liquid fire is just maybe a tad bit hotter. I personally like really spicy food so was not impressed by the wings. The burgers are good and just the right size the only issue of ordering online is you don't get all the options. Such as if you want ketchup,mustard or stuff like that you can't add it to the check list since it's not listed and you need to put it in the special instruction area

The Good: Appetizers are delicious, dahi bhalla, sev puri, pakoras, pani puri. Tandoori items are also pretty good.
The Bad: I have ordered several times online. The staff totally disregards any requests to customize the dishes. What if you have allergies?
Then, the amount of oil in the tikka masala, especially the paneer tikka masala, is disgusting. I had to keep draining out oil from the takeout container and it still kept collecting on top. My kitchen sink turned red from pouring out all the red stained oil. But, I'd rather it go down the drain than clog my arteries. Ridiculous!!! This has happened two times, so I will never order this dish again. The malai kofta described as a creamy sauce in the menu was quite the contrary. It was also served in this awful oil filled mess. I think I will only order appetizers and tandoor from this restaurant.

I think my problem was my excitement over the menu. I had high expectations. I was in a party of 4, all chosing a different dinner. the steak tacos were overflowing and enjoyed. the spicey tuna presentation was as expected, also enjoyed. I had the fish and chips. Half of the fries were soft and the slaw was incredibly under seasoned. the fish batter was light, but soggy in most areas- without lemon juice applied. We survived the night, but I'm not coming back right away.

Just wanted to quickly update my review since my previous one is three years old.  We're still coming here, and still loving it!  A Cut Above has been especially great during Covid because we can pick sandwiches up and take them to a park to eat outside.  Great if you want to get outdoors with your quarantine pod or meet up for a socially-distanced picnic with a couple friends.  I recommend ordering ahead (it took 20 - 30 minutes the last two times I've ordered), and taking your sandwiches to Ridley Creek State Park which is nearby and has picnic areas.  The staff has been so friendly taking phone orders and ringing me up when I arrive.  They are also all wearing masks.

My new favorite sandwich has been the "Pork and Cheese" with a side of the fried long hots.  The roasted pork is so tender and juicy, and it has thin slices of roasted garlic that just take it over the top.  Definitely recommend!
